capabilities: Define typed field settings globally or per fileClass note
Edit frontmatter and inline fields from context menus and Dataview tables
Autocomplete field values in the editor from preset values
Create Lookup, Canvas, Object, JSON, and YAML field types
Browse fileClass table and Kanban views
extras: The author states they can no longer dedicate much time and is looking for contributors/maintainers; full documentation lives in external demo videos rather than in the README. Known issue: autocomplete conflicts with the Various Complements plugin.
problem: Obsidian's properties are untyped free-form fields, so there is no built-in way to define field types, constrain values, or edit metadata inline from links and Dataview tables.

relations.evidence: dataview table if you have dataview plugin installed

summary: Metadata manager that gives note frontmatter and inline Dataview fields types, preset values, and editing commands from context menus.
